title: $50 Li River Cruise or a $28 Bamboo Raft? Guilin's Two Rivers | China Travel Expert
description:
Guilin's karst rivers give you two very different trips — the big Li River cruise, or a two-person bamboo raft. Which do you pick?

The classic Li River cruise runs Guilin to Yangshuo — about 83 km over 3.5–5 hours, with a buffet lunch aboard; a 4-star boat is around ¥358 (~$50), a 3-star around ¥215 (~$30). The quieter alternative is a bamboo raft on the Yulong River near Yangshuo: two people, one boatman with a pole, roughly ¥200–320 (~$28–45) depending on the route. Both drift you past the same limestone peaks — the very scene printed on China's 20-yuan note (the Li River near Xingping).

🧭 Expert Tip: Yulong rafts are capped daily and sell out — book the morning slot, and you'll beat both the heat and the tour buses.
